picks.file: TKM 4538G,Tartu Ülikooli peahoone, Georg Friedrich Schlater.jpg
picks.what: The University main building, lithograph (Tartu Art Museum)
picks.why: the university’s columned main building, Tartu’s best-known landmark, with St. John’s tower behind; sharp, high resolution

picks.what: View from the Cathedral Hill, colored lithograph (Tartu University Library)
picks.why: color general view over the town from Toome Hill; margins, color bar and caption trimmed

picks.file: The view of Tartu Town Hall from Kaarsild bridge.jpg
picks.what: The Town Hall seen from the Kaarsild bridge, photograph
picks.why: the Town Hall lit at night across the footbridge; portrait photo trimmed to the middle band

gaps: P0, P1, P2: nothing; P6 has no skyline or Quality image, only the Town Hall night shot
notes: #2 (“Dorpat”, dated 1800) is a modest general view but the round date looks like a guess and the print is weak, so it was not added as a second P3. #1 (1830 river view, ship dominates) and #8 (stone bridge, Karl Anton Schulz, dated only “19th century”) are alternatives. #11 is a worse scan of the same photo as #12. #12 can be dropped if a troop parade is not wanted as the 20th-century view.
